narrative: A small penny loaf still in the pan of a wooden scale on the bakehouse board, weights beside it, flour in the sun from a high window. An empty pie dish and a stripped mutton bone sit further down the board. No one is in the frame.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Looked once from the door, and did not go back in.

entities.name: the penny loaf
entities.context: In photo: The loaf left on the scale
